_doc: The groove of item's Line 5 profiles (20 mm modular dimension). Opening, width under the lips, depth and lip are item's table of groove dimensions; the floor's width and the angle of the flanks are scaled off item's drawing, and say so. The drawn slot leaves out the rounds at the floor and at the lips. item's groove faces also lean inward by 0.15 mm (its dimension e), so that a fastening pulls them flat: left out here.
name: slot-5-item

opening.rule: Groove opening, dimension a: 5.0 +0.3 for Line 5

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip, dimension d: 1.8 ±0.1

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, dimension b: 11.5 +0.3

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the groove's floor, dimension c: 6.35 ±0.15

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor, taken where the flanks' lines meet it: the walls run straight to about 3 mm below the face, then close in at 45 degrees, with a round where they reach the floor. Not dimensioned: measure yours
floor_width.source: scaled off item's section drawing of 0.0.370.03, https://cdn.item24.com/product-assets/GRA_PMA_PRF_37003-x_%23SALL_%23AINO_%23V2.svg (the drawing prints no figure for it)

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as drawn. Not dimensioned
flank_angle.source: scaled off item's section drawing of 0.0.370.03, https://cdn.item24.com/product-assets/GRA_PMA_PRF_37003-x_%23SALL_%23AINO_%23V2.svg (the drawing prints no figure for it)

nut_family.rule: It takes item's Line 5 T-slot nuts
